title: The two integrals of the diagonal class
statement:
Let $N\geq1$ be an integer, $A$ a finite commutative ring with $NA=0$, and $S$ a Noetherian scheme on which $N$ is invertible. Put $P=\mathbf P^1_S=\mathbf P(\{0,1\};S)$ [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change], $W=P\times_SP$ [def-pc-fibre-product], and let $p_1,p_2:W\to P$ be the projections and $\Delta:P\hookrightarrow W$ the diagonal. Work in the ordinary small etale derived categories $D(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Here $A_T$ is the constant sheaf in degree zero and $A_T(1)=\mu_{N,T}\otimes_{(\mathbf Z/N)_T}A_T$, with $\mu_{N,T}(U)=\{z\in\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_U)^\times:z^N=1\}$ and residue classes acting by powers, as in [def-amb-p1-trace]. Let $\delta=c_{\Delta,A}:R\Delta_*A_P\to A_W(1)[2]$ be the supported Kummer morphism of [lem-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer]. For $a=1,2$, let $t_{p_a}:R(p_a)_*A_W(1)[2]\to A_P$ be the projective-line trace of [def-amb-p1-trace], and let $\alpha_a:A_P\xrightarrow{\sim}R(p_a)_*R\Delta_*A_P$ be the canonical derived-composition identification from $p_a\Delta=\operatorname{id}_P$. Then both identities hold:
$$
 t_{p_a}\circ R(p_a)_*(\delta)\circ\alpha_a=\operatorname{id}_{A_P}\qquad(a=1,2).
$$
Since the etale direct image of the closed immersion $\Delta$ is exact, $R\Delta_*A_P=\Delta_*A_P$ canonically; this is the notation used in the original display. This statement uses the ordinary finite-coefficient etale twist just defined.

proof.text: The diagonal ideal of $P\to P\times_SP$ is invertible [lem-amb-p1-diagonal-cartier]; this is the Cartier witness $h_I$.

source.place: Proof, first two sentences: the diagonal is an effective Cartier divisor

proof.text: Since $N$ is invertible on $S$ it is invertible on $W$. Apply [lem-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer] to the Cartier diagonal to obtain the supported class $\kappa$ with SupportedKummerBoundary; this gives the first conjunct, and $\delta$ is its exact derived realization.

source.place: Proof, apply the supported Cartier Kummer map

proof.text: For each projection $p_a$, [lem-amb-p1-diagonal-chern-components] computes $\alpha_a\circ R(p_a)_*(\delta)\circ J_a$ as the relative hyperplane Chern adjunct plus the base Chern class followed by the twisted unit.

source.place: Proof: reduction of the supported morphism to Kummer classes of O(1)

proof.text: [lem-amb-p1-diagonal-trace-calculation] applied to $c=\delta$ and this equation gives $t_{p_a}\circ R(p_a)_*(\delta)\circ\alpha_a=\operatorname{id}_{A_P}$ for $a=1,2$.

blueprint_update.statement:
Put $W=P\times_SP$, let $p_1,p_2:W\to P$ be
the projections, and let $\Delta:P\hookrightarrow W$
be the diagonal. Its Cartier Kummer map
$\delta:\Delta_*A_P\to A_W(1)[2]$ satisfies, for
$a=1,2$,

$$
A_P=R(p_a)_*\Delta_*A_P
\xrightarrow{R(p_a)_*\delta}R(p_a)_*A_W(1)[2]
\xrightarrow{t_{p_a}} A_P
=\operatorname{id}_{A_P}.
$$

proof.text:
The equation $x_0y_1-x_1y_0=0$ shows that $\Delta$
is an effective Cartier divisor. For either projection it is
a section. Apply [lem-amb-cartier-kummer-map].
Under [cor-weil-pbc-geometric-fiber-finite], the displayed
endomorphism restricts at every geometric point of $P$ to
integration of the class of a single rational point of
$\mathbf P^1$. Its associated line bundle has degree one,
so [thm-amb-p1-decomposition], [def-amb-p1-trace] make this
value $1$. An endomorphism of the sheaf $A_P$, placed
in degree zero, is determined by its stalks. Hence the
displayed endomorphism is the identity for both projections.
